summary: Homes sit 8-9 m from this north kerb along its whole length.
reasons: Parkland is on the opposite kerb

best_section.where: Dobell Street north kerb at the west end, under the large tree

drivers.seclusion: Houses 8-9 m behind the kerb at about 16, 39 and 55 m; the western end is the least close but still near a house.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on this side; room to stop at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street; no camping convention.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of every part of the stretch
Low-lying: about 7.5 m elevation, Cubberla Creek 156 m away
The grassy reserve is across the road, on the south kerb, not this one
sun_shade: Large tree shades the west end from the east and north; the rest is open.
